occultTreasures.name: Ash-grey ring
occultTreasures.effect: A finger-width wide. All that passes through is obliterated.

occultTreasures.name: Vile flute
occultTreasures.effect: Keening music animates a fetus-sized meat golem in a nearby corpse (HP 5, Morale -, No armor, Bite d4, immune to Powers).

occultTreasures.name: Famine spoon
occultTreasures.effect: A note explains: one taste from this means death from slow starvation.

occultTreasures.name: Malevolently-accurate mirror
occultTreasures.effect: The image of a being in this mirror shows only the shameful truth of their soul.

occultTreasures.name: Vampiric phurba
occultTreasures.effect: Heals you as it harms target (d3). After stealing 6 HP total, test Presence DR14 or become addicted (daily DR12 Presence or must stab someone before sunrise or wither to ash).

occultTreasures.name: Black pearl
occultTreasures.effect: If dropped in darkness it rolls towards the nearest exit to day.

occultTreasures.name: Immortal torch
occultTreasures.effect: Burns for an immortal hour. Hold it and live; lose limbs and enter negative HP without dying unless dropped or burnt out.

occultTreasures.name: Silver bird cage
occultTreasures.effect: Slays whatever is placed behind its bars over one long night; that which is killed reanimates twice as strong as raging uncontrollable undead.

occultTreasures.name: Black Crown of the Crippled King
occultTreasures.effect: All creatures within 100 yards gain +10 attack and -10 defence. >20 crits, <1 fumbles. Only removable in pale light of a full moon.

occultTreasures.name: Ancient blindfold
occultTreasures.effect: Wearer becomes invisible to those who breathe, though undead attack them obsessively and nearby corpses awaken in unholy wrath.
